quarterly_data.signal: Fluence and LEAG Clean Power started deployment of the 400 MWh Heinersbrück GridBattery in eastern Germany, co-located with wind and solar assets and scheduled for completion in 2027; it is their second joint project after the 1GW / 4 GWh GigaBattery Jänschwalde 1000, and Fluence is responsible for design, supply and construction of both, powered by Fluence Smartstack. Fluence has contracted or deployed 35 projects in Germany with a cumulative capacity of over 6 GWh.
quarterly_data.figure: 400 MWh, completion 2027; Jänschwalde 1GW / 4 GWh; 35 projects in Germany, over 6 GWh
